text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Planned talks between the government and opposition leaders to resolve differences arising from elections held last year, hang in the balance as the government says it will not be pushed by the opposition.
- Former president Kenneth Kaunda burns voters cards collected from supporters last year after his party resolved to boycott general elections.
- President Frederick Chiluba leaves for a one-day state visit to the Democratic Republic of Congo to attend that country's 37th independence anniversary.
- A suspended high court judge threatens to sue president Frederick Chiluba within 30 days if he does not remove chief justice Mathew Ngulube from office.
